cases.input: A document moves to a new storage system and format.
cases.expect: Record identity and version chain persist; location and derived instantiation receive their own provenance and digest.

cases.input: The same word appears in two distinct subject fields.
cases.expect: Two concepts remain unless an authorized mapping or identity assertion exists.

cases.input: A concept is withdrawn from one scheme release.
cases.expect: The concept remains globally resolvable and usable in other schemes.

cases.input: A record is classified using a display label without concept and release identifiers.
Matching bytes are treated as proof that two documents or concepts are identical.
